subject: maths
question: 5 women and 2 men can complete a work in 4 days, while 6 women and 3 men can complete the same work in 3 days. How many days will one woman and one man working together take to complete the same work?
solution:
Given:

5 women and 2 men can complete a work in 4 days, while 6 women and 3 men can complete the same work in 3 days. 

Concept used:

Total work = Work done per day (Efficiency) × Total time taken

Calculation:

Let the efficiency of a man and woman be M and W respectively.

According to the question,

(5W + 2M) × 4 = (6W + 3M) × 3

⇒ 20W + 8M = 18W + 9M

⇒ 2W = M

⇒ M = 2W ....(1)

Total work = (5W + 2M) × 4

⇒ 20W + 8M

⇒ (20W + 8 × 2W) (From 1)

⇒ (20W + 16W)

⇒ 36W

Efficiency of one man and one woman = M + W

⇒ 2W + W = 3W

Now, time taken by one man and one woman to complete the task = 36W/3W

⇒ 12 days

**∴ In 12 days one woman and one man working together will take to complete the same work.**
